description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Implied fixed APY, expiry, days left and PT price for every active Pendle market on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Base, read on-chain. Filter by chain, q (symbol search), min_days. Returns JSON for each matching Pendle market: implied fixed APY, expiry, days left, and PT price.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Optional chain name for Pendle markets. Format: a chain name. The tool text names Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Base. Example: Base. Omit for all three.

min_days.description: Optional minimum days until expiry. Format: a non-negative number of days. Example: 30. Omit to include every expiry.

q.description: Optional symbol search inside the market name. Format: a short token symbol. Example: ETH. Omit for every active market.

name: pendle_fixed
title: Pendle PT fixed APY ($0.01)
